decision.rationale: I recommend a provisional credit of 118.75 EUR, the difference between the posted amount and the receipt. TXN-008171 is on card CRD-000181. It posted on 2026-09-12 for 37142 cents. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-26, 44 days later, which is inside the 120-day limit in time-limits. The authorisation AUTH-008355 was for 25267 cents. The merchant's receipt DOC-000089 shows a total of 25267 cents (252.67 EUR). The posted amount is higher than both the receipt and the authorisation, so under amount-above-receipt the extra 37142 - 25267 = 11875 cents was charged without agreement. The policy allows credit for the difference only. The cardholder asks for the full 371.42 EUR, but that does not change the amount: provisional-credit never allows more than the part in dispute. 118.75 EUR is well under the 3,000.00 EUR limit for automated credit.
